mechanism: Nicotine increases heart rate and blood pressure while berberine may have hypotensive and bradycardic effects, creating opposing cardiovascular effects; berberine may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially affecting nicotine metabolism.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; counsel patients on reduced nicotine intake or cessation; consider alternative berberine sources if cardiovascular instability occurs.
